description: Connect your AI assistant directly to Trata — the fastest-growing library of investment research, centered on anonymous hedge fund debate. With Trata MCP, your assistant will have the tools to reason across hundreds of calls in our library. It goes beyond simple searches to help breakdown bull and bear cases, compare analyst sentiment across time, and deep dive into stock analysis. We compress what would take hours of analyst research into a single question.

defaultPrompt: Show me transcripts for LYFT and UBER over the past 3 months.
Which transcripts debate whether AI capex is actually paying off?
Which large-cap technology tickers are covered the most on Trata?
